title: 17705 - 17705/P1297/004759
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Leaking Hoses and/or Pipes between Components
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Hoses and Pipes between Components
Kontrol edin:  / Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Turbocharger Recirculating Valve (N249) (Diverter Valve)

Kontrol edin:  / Temizleyin:  Gaz Kelebeği Ünitesi
Gerçekleştirin: Gaz Kelebeği Ünitesi Alignment (TBA)
Kontrol edin:  for Vacuum leak(s) including PCV system
Kontrol edin:  / Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Boost Pressure Control Valve (N75)
technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: the NAR 2.0T (BPY) Kontrol edin: RVUTB: 01-09-03  or  2018919 for updated Crankcase Breather Valve
If the breather valve is faulty, full engine vacuum is typically found when removing the oil cap at idle.
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: 1.8T engines, such as the (3B) B5/B5.5 Passat, Kontrol edin: the PCV "bleeder valve". Example part number 06B-103-245
One way to troubleshoot the problem is to pinch closed the vacuum supply hose that attaches to the bleeder valve to see if the excessive crankcase vacuum is resolve resulting in a smooth idle.
model: 911, Passat, Golf, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco, Jetta, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, TT, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, Taycan
